conditions.fear: Work in this stance: fear. Ask of the list, what here will hurt us if it is missing?
conditions.love: Work in this stance: love. Ask of the list, what here do we cherish and want more of?
conditions.openness: Work in this stance: openness. Ask of the list, what has nobody put here?
conditions.control: Work in this stance: control. Ask of the list, what must be pinned down in writing?
conditions.calm: Work in this stance: calm. Nothing here is urgent and nothing is at stake.

placement: the stance is prepended to the grow, typology, and gap-fill prompts; the gate prompt is unchanged, so every condition is judged by the same standard
command: IDEONOMY_DATA=<dir with data/*.jsonl plus the copied record> bin/ideonomy climb --only cooperation-ignitions--<stance> --breaths 3 --stance '<preamble>'
why_a_separate_data_dir: loadPool injects the eleven hard-coded seed lists and saveGrown re-sorts and re-encodes the whole catalog file, so the climb never runs against data/ itself
